build.environmentControl: DEBUG was removed from the command environment for both clean release builds
build.profile: Stock ESP32C3_IDF5 feature and memory profile: WiFi, Bluetooth, TLS, filesystem, graphics and crypto; 4095 configured variables and ESP_HEAP_SIZE=70000
build.optimization: ESP32C3_IDF5 applies -Og to Espruino component sources; ESP-IDF sdkconfig has CONFIG_COMPILER_OPTIMIZATION_SIZE=y
build.partitionAuthority: ESP-IDF generated partition table and check_sizes.py result for the produced IDF5 image
build.disabledCommand: env -u DEBUG make BOARD=ESP32C3_IDF5 clean && env -u DEBUG make BOARD=ESP32C3_IDF5 RELEASE=1 USE_XFSM=0 -j2
build.disabledResult: pass: RISC-V compile, link, app image and ESP-IDF partition-size check completed
build.enabledCommand: env -u DEBUG make BOARD=ESP32C3_IDF5 clean && env -u DEBUG make BOARD=ESP32C3_IDF5 RELEASE=1 USE_XFSM=1 -j2
build.enabledResult: pass: XFSM and wrapper sources compiled and linked for RISC-V and passed the ESP-IDF partition-size check

integration.selection: USE_XFSM=1 used Espruino's normal optional-library mechanism
integration.xfsmSymbol: jswrap_xfsm_createMachine present in the linked RISC-V ELF
integration.boardFileFlashConstant: ESP32_FLASH_MAX=1572864 is not used by the ESP32_IDF5 Make target; the generated 2048000-byte app partition is checked by ESP-IDF

artifacts.retention: Transient local build artifacts; not committed

scope: Build feasibility only. No physical-device runtime, semantic, RAM, stack, timing, GC, save/restore, WiFi/BLE coexistence or hardware-action conformance is claimed.
